items.title: Approve the Minutes of the February 28, 2023 Meeting
Adopt the Recommendations of the Caltrain 22nd Street Station ADA Access Improvement Feasibility Study for the Preferred Improvements to Achieve Street to Platform Accessibility
Allocate $16,406,910 and Appropriate $687,236 in Prop K Funds, with Conditions, and Allocate $2,882,492 in Prop AA Funds for 23 Requests
Allocate Prop K Funds, with Conditions, for Downtown Rail Extension Engineering Development; Program Oversight and Technical Tasks; and Pre-Environmental Bridging Study
Award Construction Contracts to Golden State Bridge/Obayashi Joint Venture; WMH Corporation; with WSP USA, Inc. for the Westside Bridges Seismic Retrofit Project
